+import pytest
+from gpt_engineer.core.ai import AI
+
+def test_vision_flag_for_gpt_4_turbo():
+    # The vision flag should be True for 'gpt-4-turbo' model
+    ai = AI(model_name="gpt-4-turbo")
+    assert ai.vision is True
+
+    # Also True for 'gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09'
+    ai2 = AI(model_name="gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09")
+    assert ai2.vision is True
+
+    # Should be False for 'gpt-4-turbo-preview'
+    ai3 = AI(model_name="gpt-4-turbo-preview")
+    assert ai3.vision is False
+
+    # Should be True for 'vision-preview' in model name
+    ai4 = AI(model_name="gpt-4-vision-preview")
+    assert ai4.vision is True
+
+    # Should be False for unrelated model
+    ai5 = AI(model_name="gpt-3.5-turbo")
+    assert ai5.vision is False
task_info.problem_statement:
Missing support for the vision capabilities in the new model gpt-4-turbo
## Expected Behavior

When using the model gpt-4-turbo, I expect the vision capabilities to work so that I can send in image inputs using the --image_directory flag.

## Current Behavior

When using the --image_directory flag and the model gpt-4-turbo, the images in the directory are ignored and not sent to the model.

##
A simple fix would be to update the dependency to langchain to reference v0.1.16 or later that have better support for gpt-4-turbo.
https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/releases/tag/v0.1.16

And: 

In core/ai.py one could change this on row 110:
`self.vision = "vision" in model_name`
to
`self.vision = "vision" in model_name or model_name in ["gpt-4-turbo", "gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09"]`
